testcase.name: Subnormal and extreme durations: exact cycles for small multiples of Double.MIN_VALUE; huge durations stay in cycle 0 (section 5)
Time-translation invariance: shifting every instant by the same amount changes no bit, in both domains (sections 3, 4)
Stage and cycle are monotone in local time for finite runs: never AFTER -> ACTIVE or a lower cycle later (section 5)
COSMETIC differences beyond 2^53 ns round twice, as specified, and stay within 2 ulp of the exact quotient (section 3)
Boundary oracle: on and next to 11 cycle boundaries up to 2^51 - 1, for 14 durations including subnormals, stage and cycle are exact and forward progress is correctly rounded (sections 5, 6.4)
Determinism under JIT: results computed before and after 3 million hot iterations are bit-identical (section 6.1)
Integer control scripts: random pause/resume/restart/seek/withRate (integer rates in [-3, 3]) match a pure long-arithmetic model bit for bit, through Timing as well (section 6.3)
Re-anchoring error: GAME stays within the contract's 1.5 * 2^-52 * M; COSMETIC needs 2.5 * 2^-52 * M (finding A1: the contract's 1.5 is exceeded)
Exhaustive small integers: every delay in [-6, 6], duration in [1, 8], local in [-30, 90], all modes and cycle counts agree with integer arithmetic (section 6.3)
The 2^51 cycle-exact domain is sufficient: 200,000 random elapsed times with elapsed/duration in [2^50, 2^51) give the exact cycle (section 6.4)
PING_PONG mirror symmetry: for integer d and u in [0, 2d], progress(u) == progress(2d - u) bit for bit (section 5)
Validation order: control-instant checks, then argument checks, then evaluation; so an invalid rate is an IAE even where evaluation would overflow (section 4)
